Shadow Cavern.description: Torchlight flickers. a stone altar stands near the entrance, and stones grind softly nearby.

Ancient Depths.description: Shadows dance across the walls across the cave. damp cave surfaces surrounds you while saltwater drifts through the chamber. You suddenly spot a Fire Spirit watching you carefully.

Whispering Hollow.description: wind whistles through cracks. broken statues rests beneath spiral markings, and a strange stillness fills the chamber. You suddenly spot a Moʻo watching you carefully.

Forgotten Passage.description: Shadows dance across the walls across the ruins. rough stone walls surrounds you while sulfur hangs in the air. You suddenly spot a Moʻo watching you carefully.

Temple of Fire.description: Torchlight flickers. The air feels heavy inside the cave, and a weathered shrine sits beneath ancient Hawaiian symbols. The legendary Maui Stone radiates power before you.
